adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` the onError handler builds `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;` and then calls `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), "error")`. Because this is a template literal, `message` is always a (non-empty) string; when `err.data?.code` is undefined it becomes the literal text `"undefined: ..."`, so the fallback `t("unable_to_add_guests")` is effectively dead and the UI can show `undefined:` to users.
